deadline.value: No central deadline: positions are advertised on the department vacancies page about four times a year (normally Feb, Apr, Sep, Oct), each with its own deadline. The page lists only 2025 dates
deadline.quote: All open positions are announced on the departmental vacancies webpage. This is done four times per year. Announcements are normally published February, April, September and October.

app_fee.value: Not stated on the page checked

fee_waiver.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_general.value: Not stated on the page checked

gre_physics.value: Not stated on the page checked

toefl_min.value: Department page: TOEFL iBT 79 (paper 550) or IELTS Academic 6.0 with no section below 5.0. Sweden's national English 6 standard (University Admissions) is higher at TOEFL iBT 90 with 20 in writing, so confirm with the department
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL score of 550 or more (computer based test 213, internet based 79) | IELTS score (Academic) of 6.0 or more (with none of the sections scoring less than 5.0) | You are also required to have knowledge of English corresponding to English B / English 6 in high school.

also.quote: For English 6/English Level 2*: Score of 20 (scale 0-30) in written test, total score of 90

english_waiver.value: A previously completed university degree taught in English is listed as meeting the English requirement (as an alternative to IELTS/TOEFL)
english_waiver.quote: Good knowledge in English is required. At least is needed something equivalent to the Swedish high-school course English B or: | Previously completed University degree taught in English

supervisor.value: You apply to a specific advertised position and are assessed against the other applicants for it; at least two supervisors are appointed in connection with admission
supervisor.quote: Your qualifications will be assessed in competion with other applicants for the same advertised position. | In connection with admission, at least two supervisors are appointed, one of which is your main supervisor.

funding.value: Funding for the whole study period (normally 4 years) is a condition of admission; in most cases you are employed as a PhD student with a salary
funding.quote: A condition for admission, in addition to possessing the required educational qualifications, is that the student will have sufficient economic support during the whole period of study, normally 4 years full time study. In most cases you will be employed as PhD student for your period of studies.

also.quote: As a doctoral student, you will normally be employed at the Department of Physics and receive a salary to be able to support yourself during your studies.

entry_route.value: 240 credits (a master's or 4-year degree) including at least 60 credits of advanced-level physics and an advanced-level physics degree project of at least 15 credits (a BSc project does not count)
entry_route.quote: You have an advanced level degree (master or 4-year degree) or have studied courses corresponding to at least 240 credits (4 years of studies) | You have completed a degree project in Physics at advanced level (not a BSc degree project) corresponding to at least 15 credits. | You have studied courses at advanced level in physics of at least 60 credits.

notes: Fysikum's doctoral subjects are Physics, Theoretical Physics, Chemical Physics and Medical Radiation Physics. Applicants not known from SU undergraduate studies normally have to show their qualifications by taking one or two advanced-level courses or doing a suitable project (eligibility page). The call dates on the page are for 2025; check the department vacancies page for the 2026-27 calls.
